dispute.claim_text: I ordered a pair of headphones on September 1 with delivery promised within a week. They never arrived. The tracking has never shown a delivery. The merchant insists it shipped but cannot show it was delivered to me.

evidence.text: Order confirmation: wireless headphones, USD 340.00, estimated delivery by 2026-09-08.
Tracking history: 'Label created 2026-09-02.' No further scans. Status never reached 'Delivered'.
Merchant support reply: 'Our records show it shipped.' Provides no proof of delivery; does not resolve the claim.

labels.notes: Clear case. Critical point 13.1-r1 is consumer-supported: tracking never shows delivery, and the merchant offers no proof of receipt. Burden is on the merchant to prove delivery; they cannot.
